name: Potentially Suspicious GrantedAccess Flags On LSASS
description: Detects process access requests to LSASS process with potentially suspicious access flags
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate software such as AV and EDR
query: (winlog.event_data.TargetImage:*\\lsass.exe AND ((winlog.event_data.GrantedAccess:(*30 OR *50 OR *70 OR *90 OR *B0 OR *D0 OR *F0 OR *18 OR *38 OR *58 OR *78 OR *98 OR *B8 OR *D8 OR *F8 OR *1A OR *3A OR *5A OR *7A OR *9A OR *BA OR *DA OR *FA OR *0x14C2)) OR (winlog.event_data.GrantedAccess:(0x100000* OR 0x1418* OR 0x1438* OR 0x143a* OR 0x1f0fff* OR 0x1f1fff* OR 0x1f2fff* OR 0x1f3fff* OR 0x40*)))) AND (NOT ((process.executable:(*\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\* OR *\:\\Program\ Files\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\System32\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*)) OR (process.executable:*\:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows\ Defender\\* AND process.executable:*\\MsMpEng.exe) OR ((winlog.event_data.CallTrace:*\|?\:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows\ Defender\\Definition\ Updates\\\{* AND winlog.event_data.CallTrace:*\}\\mpengine.dll\+*) AND winlog.event_data.GrantedAccess:0x1418) OR (winlog.event_data.CallTrace:(*\|c\:\\program\ files\\windows\ defender\\mprtp.dll* OR *\|c\:\\program\ files\\windows\ defender\\MpClient.dll*)) OR (process.executable:*\\explorer.exe AND winlog.event_data.GrantedAccess:0x401))) AND (NOT (process.executable:*\:\\ProgramData\\MALWAREBYTES\\MBAMSERVICE\\ctlrupdate\\mbupdatr.exe OR process.executable:*\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\Microsoft\ VS\ Code\\Code.exe OR (process.executable:*\:\\ProgramData\\VMware\\VMware\ Tools\\* AND process.executable:*\\vmtoolsd.exe) OR ((process.executable:(*\\PROCEXP64.EXE OR *\\PROCEXP.EXE)) AND winlog.event_data.GrantedAccess:0x40) OR (process.executable:*\\MBAMInstallerService.exe AND winlog.event_data.GrantedAccess:0x40) OR ((process.executable:(*\\aurora\-agent\-64.exe OR *\\aurora\-agent.exe OR *\\thor.exe OR *\\thor64.exe)) AND winlog.event_data.GrantedAccess:0x40) OR ((process.executable:(*\\handle.exe OR *\\handle64.exe)) AND winlog.event_data.GrantedAccess:0x40) OR (process.executable:*\\AppData\\Local\\WebEx\\WebexHost.exe AND winlog.event_data.GrantedAccess:0x401) OR process.executable:*\\SteamLibrary\\steamapps\\*))
